text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a species distribution modeling study focusing on the woolly monkey as an umbrella species to assess conservation potential of Protected Areas under future climate change and deforestation scenarios in Colombia. Although it includes a deforestation projection, the primary focus is on species distribution changes and conservation biology, not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation as a central research question. There is no indication of a national-scale spatial implementation of LULC modeling with multiple future scenarios quantitatively compared as the main objective. The LULC (deforestation) projection is used as an input to assess species distribution impact rather than as a primary research focus. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction papers and is excluded.)
